# Mail the low-stock report every the week

## Problem

The clerks open the low-stock report by hand. They want it mailed.

## Users

The 3 shift leads get the e-mail.

## Goals

- The low-stock report is mailed every the week to the 3 shift leads.

## Non-goals

- Other reports.

## Success measures

- Each of the 3 shift leads gets the mail every the week. What target does the owner want for a measure?

## Open questions

- Which time on the week does the mail go out?
